BROWSER AGENT · OFFICIAL-SOURCE REVIEW

Browser Use

让 AI Agent 操作真实浏览器的开源 Python 库，并延伸到托管 Agent 与浏览器基础设施。

An open-source Python library for agents operating real browsers, extended by hosted agents and browser infrastructure.

结论：浏览器自动化是 Agent 最直接的落地场景之一，Browser Use 也有成熟的开源入口。适合验证网页采集和重复流程，但登录态、支付、个人数据与反自动化策略使它不适合未经约束地执行高风险任务。
Verdict: Browser automation is one of the clearest agent use cases, and Browser Use offers a mature open-source entry point. It suits extraction and repeatable workflows, but authenticated, financial and personal-data tasks require strict controls.

开源项目和云服务要分开看

官方将产品分为三条路径：托管 Agent、供现有 Agent 调用的 CLI，以及可连接本地或云浏览器的开源 Python 库。开源仓库采用 MIT 许可，但托管浏览器、代理、验证码处理和模型调用可能形成持续成本。

这也是它最容易被误读的地方：Star 反映开源项目关注度，不等于云服务客户数、任务成功率或企业采用度。

为什么是 79 分？

Separate open source from cloud

The official product has three paths: hosted agents, a CLI for existing agents, and an open Python library connected to local or cloud browsers. The repository is MIT licensed, while managed browsers, proxies, CAPTCHA handling and model calls can create recurring cost.

GitHub stars measure interest in the open repository—not cloud customers, task success or enterprise adoption.

部署前的四条边界

  • 把“只读采集”和“会提交表单、发送消息、付款”的动作分级。
  • 使用隔离浏览器配置，不把日常账号和全部 Cookie 暴露给 Agent。
  • 关键提交前要求人工确认，并为任务设置域名、时间和费用上限。
  • 分别记录本地库、云浏览器、模型与代理成本，避免把开源误当免费。

来源与边界

架构和产品路径来自 Browser Use 官方仓库及官方组织资料；指标来自 GitHub REST API。尚未完成跨网站成功率和安全实测，初评置信度 65%。

Four deployment boundaries

  • Separate read-only extraction from actions that submit, message or purchase.
  • Use isolated browser profiles instead of exposing daily accounts and all cookies.
  • Require confirmation before consequential actions and cap domains, time and spend.
  • Track library, browser, model and proxy costs separately.

Sources and limits

Architecture and product paths come from the official repository and organization materials. Metrics come from the GitHub REST API. Cross-site success and security remain untested; confidence is 65%.
